# Nimbus

> Kotlin Multiplatform (Android · JVM · iOS) download manager library.
> Targets: Android minSdk 21, JVM 17, iOS.
> All errors are returned as typed values — no exceptions thrown across the public API.

## Coordinates

```
# Core library
io.github.giovanniandreuzza:nimbus:<version>

# Optional Ktor HTTP adapter (recommended — saves you implementing NimbusDownloadPort)
io.github.giovanniandreuzza:nimbus-ktor:<version>
```

## Initialisation (do once, store the result in your DI container)

```kotlin
// build() + init() — both are plain (non-suspending) functions.
// init() starts loading persisted tasks in the background and returns NimbusAPI immediately.
// The first actual API call suspends briefly if loading is still in progress;
// all subsequent calls proceed without delay once loading has completed.
val api: NimbusAPI = Nimbus.Builder()
    .withNimbusDownloadPort(ktorAdapter)      // required — your HTTP client adapter
    .withDownloadManagerPath(storePath)       // required — path for the metadata store
    .withConcurrencyLimit(2)                  // optional, default 1
    .withDownloadBufferSize(8 * 1024L)        // optional, default 8 KB
    .withDownloadNotifyEveryBytes(512 * 1024L)// optional, default ~512 KB
    .withMaxRetryAttempts(3)                  // optional, default 3
    .withRetryBaseDelayMs(500L)               // optional, default 500 ms
    .withMinReservedDiskBytes(50 * 1024 * 1024L) // optional — disk headroom guard
    .withAutoStart(true)                      // optional, default false
    .withNimbusLogger(myLogger)               // optional
    .build()
    .init()

// One-liner convenience (equivalent):
val api: NimbusAPI = Nimbus.Builder()….createAndInit()
```

If loading fails (e.g. corrupt store), `NimbusError.InitializationFailed` is returned by the
first API call rather than at `init()` time.

## NimbusAPI — complete method reference

All methods are `suspend` unless noted. All return `KResult<T, NimbusError>` except
`isDownloaded` (returns `Boolean`) and `getAllDownloads` (returns `List<DownloadTaskDTO>`).

```kotlin
// Query
suspend fun isDownloaded(fileUrl: String): Boolean
suspend fun getFileSize(fileUrl: String): KResult<Long, NimbusError>
suspend fun getDownloadTask(fileUrl: String): KResult<DownloadTaskDTO, NimbusError>
suspend fun getAllDownloads(): List<DownloadTaskDTO>

// Lifecycle
suspend fun enqueueDownload(fileUrl: String, filePath: String, fileName: String): KResult<DownloadTaskDTO, NimbusError>
suspend fun startDownload(fileUrl: String): KResult<Unit, NimbusError>
suspend fun observeDownload(fileUrl: String): KResult<Flow<DownloadState>, NimbusError>
suspend fun pauseDownload(fileUrl: String): KResult<Unit, NimbusError>
suspend fun resumeDownload(fileUrl: String): KResult<Unit, NimbusError>
suspend fun cancelDownload(fileUrl: String): KResult<Unit, NimbusError>  // also deletes partial file

// Cleanup
suspend fun removeDownload(fileUrl: String, deleteAssociatedFile: Boolean = false): KResult<Unit, NimbusError>
// removeDownload only succeeds when state is Finished or Failed; use cancelDownload for active tasks.

// Auto-start (when withAutoStart(true) is set on the Builder)
// enqueueDownload automatically fires startDownload in the background — no manual call needed.
// Any failure from the background start is emitted as NimbusLogEvent.AutoStartFailed and the
// task stays Enqueued so it can be started manually. Internal transient-error retry
// (maxRetryAttempts / retryBaseDelayMs) still applies once the download is running.

// Recovery
suspend fun retryFailedDownload(fileUrl: String): KResult<Unit, NimbusError>
// Refetches remote size, deletes partial file, resets state to Enqueued. Call startDownload after.

// High-level convenience
suspend fun ensureDownloaded(fileUrl: String, filePath: String, fileName: String): KResult<Flow<DownloadState>, NimbusError>
// Handles the full lifecycle automatically:
//   already finished  → returns flowOf(DownloadState.Finished)
//   stale finished    → clears metadata, re-downloads
//   failed            → calls retryFailedDownload, then starts
//   paused/enqueued   → resumes or starts, returns observeDownload flow
//   not found         → enqueues, starts, returns observeDownload flow
```

## DownloadState sealed class

```kotlin
sealed class DownloadState {
    data object Enqueued : DownloadState()
    data class  Downloading(val progress: Double) : DownloadState()  // 0.0–100.0
    data class  Paused(val progress: Double) : DownloadState()       // 0.0–100.0
    data class  Failed(val error: KError) : DownloadState()
    data object Finished : DownloadState()
}
```

`observeDownload` returns a `Flow<DownloadState>` that **auto-completes** when the state
reaches `Finished` or `Failed`. No manual cancellation needed.

## DownloadTaskDTO fields

```kotlin
data class DownloadTaskDTO(
    val id: String,        // SHA-256 of fileUrl — stable across sessions
    val fileName: String,
    val fileUrl: String,
    val filePath: String,
    val fileSize: Long,    // bytes
    val state: DownloadState,
    val version: Int
)
```

## NimbusError sealed class — exhaustive list

```kotlin
sealed class NimbusError {
    // Input validation (before any network call)
    object InvalidUrl           // fileUrl is not http/https
    object InvalidPath          // filePath contains ".." traversal component
    object InvalidFileName      // fileName is blank, ".", "..", or contains / \ \0
    class  InvalidFileSize      // remote reported size <= 0
    object DownloadNotFound     // no task registered for this fileUrl
    class  FilePathInUse(filePath: String)  // another task already targets this filePath
    class  InsufficientDiskSpace(path: String, requiredBytes: Long, availableBytes: Long)

    // State machine violations
    class  InvalidState(currentState: DownloadState)  // operation not allowed in this state

    // Initialisation
    class  InitializationFailed(cause: KError)

    // Network / storage
    object ResourceNotFound     // HTTP 404
    class  TemporaryError       // transient; retry is safe
    class  PermanentError       // non-recoverable
    class  UnexpectedError      // programmer error / unhandled exception
}
```

## KResult usage patterns

```kotlin
// Unwrap or return early
val task = api.enqueueDownload(url, path, name).getOr { error ->
    // error: NimbusError
    return
}

// Side-effect on failure only
api.startDownload(url).onFailure { error -> log(error) }

// Exhaustive fold
api.getDownloadTask(url).fold(
    onSuccess = { dto -> show(dto) },
    onFailure = { error ->
        when (error) {
            NimbusError.DownloadNotFound -> showEmpty()
            is NimbusError.TemporaryError -> showRetry()
            else -> showError(error)
        }
    }
)
```

## Common patterns

### Simple download (manual steps)

```kotlin
// All these calls must happen inside a coroutine.
api.enqueueDownload(url, filePath, fileName).getOr { return@launch }
api.startDownload(url).getOr { return@launch }
api.observeDownload(url).getOr { return@launch }.collect { state ->
    when (state) {
        DownloadState.Enqueued         -> { /* waiting */ }
        is DownloadState.Downloading   -> updateProgress(state.progress)
        is DownloadState.Paused        -> showPaused(state.progress)
        is DownloadState.Failed        -> showError(state.error)
        DownloadState.Finished         -> showDone()
    }
}
```

### One-liner convenience (recommended)

```kotlin
api.ensureDownloaded(url, filePath, fileName).getOr { return@launch }.collect { state ->
    when (state) { … }
}
```

### Pause and resume

```kotlin
api.pauseDownload(url).onFailure { log(it) }
// Later:
api.resumeDownload(url).getOr { return@launch }
api.observeDownload(url).getOr { return@launch }.collect { … }
```

### Retry after failure

```kotlin
api.retryFailedDownload(url).getOr { return@launch }
api.startDownload(url).getOr { return@launch }
api.observeDownload(url).getOr { return@launch }.collect { … }
```

### Cleanup after finish

```kotlin
// Remove metadata only (keep file on disk):
api.removeDownload(url)
// Remove metadata AND delete file:
api.removeDownload(url, deleteAssociatedFile = true)
```

## State machine — valid transitions

```
Enqueued  ──startDownload──►  Downloading  ──pauseDownload──►  Paused
                                    │                              │
                                    │                         resumeDownload
                                    ▼                              │
                                Finished ◄─────────────────────────┘
                                    │
                                 (error)
                                    ▼
                                 Failed  ──retryFailedDownload──► Enqueued
```

`cancelDownload` is valid from any state and removes both metadata and the partial file.
`removeDownload` is only valid from `Finished` or `Failed`.

## What Nimbus does NOT do

- Does not validate that `filePath`'s parent directory exists — create it before calling `enqueueDownload`.
- Does not enforce a process-wide singleton — use your DI container's `single {}` for that.
- Does not support non-HTTP(S) URLs.
- Does not resume downloads that were `Enqueued` but never started across sessions —
  call `startDownload` again after `init()` if you want auto-resume on restart.

## Implementing NimbusDownloadPort (required if not using nimbus-ktor)

```kotlin
interface NimbusDownloadPort {
    suspend fun getFileSize(fileUrl: String): KResult<Long, GetFileSizeError>
    suspend fun downloadFile(
        fileUrl: String,
        offset: Long,
        onSourceOpened: suspend (Source) -> Unit
    ): KResult<Unit, DownloadError>
}
```

The `onSourceOpened` lambda receives a `kotlinx.io.Source`. Stream it to the sink Nimbus
provides internally — do not buffer the entire response in memory.

**HTTP resume contract** (what your implementation must handle):
- When `offset > 0`, send `Range: bytes=offset-`.
- Accept **206** with matching `Content-Range` start byte.
- Reject **200** with a non-empty body when offset > 0 — this would corrupt the file
  (`DownloadError.InconsistentRangeResponse`).
- Map **416** → `DownloadError.RangeNotSatisfiable`.

## Using KtorDownloadAdapter (nimbus-ktor artifact)

```kotlin
// Add dependency: io.github.giovanniandreuzza:nimbus-ktor:<version>
import io.github.giovanniandreuzza.nimbus.ktor.KtorDownloadAdapter

val adapter = KtorDownloadAdapter(httpClient)   // caller owns HttpClient lifecycle

val api = Nimbus.Builder()
    .withNimbusDownloadPort(adapter)
    .withDownloadManagerPath(storePath)
    .build()
    .init()
    .getOr { … }
```

`KtorDownloadAdapter` handles:
- `HEAD` for size; falls back to `GET Range: bytes=0-0` + `Content-Range` when `Content-Length` is absent.
- 206 / 200 / 416 mapping to the typed `DownloadError` hierarchy.
- `InconsistentRangeResponse` guard for servers that return a full 200 body on a resume request.

## Android — withAndroidContext extension

On Android, you can call `.withAndroidContext(context)` on the Builder to have the storage
adapter automatically resolve paths relative to the app's files directory.

## Optional: NimbusLogger

```kotlin
fun interface NimbusLogger {
    suspend fun log(event: NimbusLogEvent)
}
```

`NimbusLogEvent` variants:

```kotlin
sealed class NimbusLogEvent {
    data class DownloadEnqueued(val fileUrl: String, val filePath: String, val expectedSizeBytes: Long)
    data class DownloadStartRequested(val fileUrl: String)
    data class DownloadFinished(val fileUrl: String)
    data class DownloadFailed(val fileUrl: String, val error: NimbusError)
    data class EnsureDownloadedAlreadyComplete(val fileUrl: String)
    data class EnsureDownloadedStaleFinishedRemoved(val fileUrl: String)
    data class InsufficientDiskSpace(val fileUrl: String?, val path: String, val requiredBytes: Long, val availableBytes: Long)
    data class AutoStartFailed(val fileUrl: String, val error: NimbusError)
}
```

Implementations should be fast and non-throwing; dispatch to a background dispatcher if needed.
